name: Sal Worringham
reason: Strict health rule: The Willow Clinic site sells her Bowen and therapeutic sessions as a clinic for healing and treatment, the Bowen copy cites relief of anxiety and help with sleep, and her about page carries a testimonial crediting her with overcoming anxiety, depression and trauma; a listing would send people there even with the therapies left out. Her yoga and meditation classes in Wonersh and on Zoom are themselves clean, so a human may still want to look.
